claim: A parameterized physics-informed neural network with a learned latent space can improve the quality of convection-diffusion-reaction (CDR) solutions across thousands of equations.
falsifier: Train a parameterized physics-informed neural network with latent space on a set of CDR equations, then evaluate solution quality on held-out CDR equations; compare to non-parameterized baselines.

conditions: the evaluation covers thousands of CDR equations
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported CDR equations and the specific P2INN architecture; transfer to other PDE types is unestablished.

title: Using a parameterized architecture–quality of CDR solutions principle

claim: Linear propagation loss in PECVD silicon nitride waveguides is wavelength-dependent, peaking near 1520 nm (0.816 eV) due to chemical bond absorption, and decreasing when detuned from the absorption peak.
falsifier: Measure propagation loss in PECVD SiN waveguides at multiple wavelengths around 1520 nm; verify that loss peaks at ~1520 nm and decreases with detuning.

exclusions: limited to the reported PECVD system and experimental conditions

title: Wavelength–linear propagation loss principle

claim: To reach a raw contrast limit of 10^-10 in a space coronagraph, the optical wavefront must be stabilized to approximately 10 pm rms from the telescope primary mirror down to the science focal plane, requiring system-level optimization of the technologies.
falsifier: In an end-to-end coronagraph model, vary the rms wavefront error from the primary mirror to the focal plane and compute the raw contrast; the contrast should reach 10^-10 only when the rms error is near 10 pm.

conditions: the wavefront is propagated from the telescope primary mirror down to the science focal plane
the technologies are optimized altogether at the system level
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported technology roadmap and the reviewed high-contrast space mission context; transfer beyond this context is unestablished.

title: Space-based high-contrast coronagraphic telescope–raw contrast limit…
